name: Achenseebahn
kurzbeschreibung: The oldest still-operating steam rack railway in Europe – a nostalgic journey from **Jenbach** up to **Achensee**, through untouched nature.
beschreibung: The Achenseebahn is a technical landmark of the highest order: it is the oldest steam rack railway in Europe still in operation (since 1889). The 7 km route climbs from Jenbach (530 m) up to Achensee (931 m), overcoming a steep 400 meters in elevation with gradients of up to 16%—powered by an original preserved steam locomotive with rack-and-pinion drive. The journey through dense forests and along dizzying cliffs is a nostalgic experience for all ages. Upon arrival, the railway connects directly with the Achensee boat service.
oeffnungszeiten: Mai–Okt: 3–4 Fahrten täglich (Dampfbetrieb); Nov–Apr: eingeschränkter Betrieb
